Context: T. A. when deputed for training

- 3.. If theoretical training and practical training are given in two different stations, D..A. in the second station will commence afresh irrespective of whether D.A. was drawn for 180 days or less in the first station. If both theoretical and practical trainings are at the same station, D.A. will be admissible for the first 180 days only. - GIO (4), SR 164.
